known_differences.description: fsci-interpolate implements CubicSpline, PCHIP, Akima1D, BSpline, RegularGridInterpolator, griddata, RBFInterpolator, and FITPACK wrappers.

threats.description: Oscillatory overshoot on non-smooth 1D data when cubic splines are used instead of shape-preserving PCHIP or Akima splines.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-interpolate/src/lib.rs:998 (pchip_interpolate): computes Fritsch-Carlson monotone harmonic derivatives that prevent extrema between data knots.
threats.strict_mode_response: Preserve monotonicity on each subinterval matching SciPy PchipInterpolator.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate finite knots and values and emit FailClosed on violation.

threats.description: Non-strictly-increasing knot sequences x, duplicate abscissas, or mismatched x/y lengths passed to spline constructors.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-interpolate/src/lib.rs:1453 (akima1d_interpolate): verifies strictly increasing x, matching y length, and minimum knot count before constructing segments.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(InterpolateError) on non-increasing x or shape mismatch.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed and record AuditAction::FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Full B-spline basis evaluation over large knot vectors wasting O(n_knots) work per query instead of compact-support O(k) evaluation.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-interpolate/src/lib.rs:4543 (interpn): restricts evaluation to the active knot span and grid cell via binary search.
threats.strict_mode_response: Evaluate only compactly supported basis functions matching full basis bit-for-bit.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce grid bounds or extrapolation policy fail-closed.

threats.description: Scattered 2D/nD interpolation (griddata) behavior on points outside the convex hull of data sites.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-interpolate/src/lib.rs:3751 (griddata): returns fill_value (default NaN) for query points outside the Delaunay convex hull in linear/cubic modes.
threats.strict_mode_response: Fill out-of-hull queries with fill_value matching SciPy griddata.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate point cloud dimension and finiteness before triangulation.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: non-increasing x coordinates or duplicate knots
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return InterpolateError::NonIncreasingX and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject non-finite inputs when constructing interpolators.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite inputs and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: out-of-bounds query when bounds_error is enabled
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return InterpolateError::OutOfBounds and log FailClosed event.
